snippet.title: DX Legends - Reveal trailer
snippet.description:
🚀 DX Legends reveal trailer is here! Watch it now! ⚔️

Wishlist now to support the project & get notified at launch! (link in comment!)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3564110/DX_Legends

DX Legends – Chaos, Strategy, and Legendary Battles!
In DX Legends, the battlefield is unpredictable, the stakes are high, and the princess won’t save herself! This fast-paced online battle arena blends action, chaos, and strategy in multiple game modes. Whether you’re fighting solo or teaming up, every match is a test of skill, reflexes, and adaptability.

Will you rise as a legend or be lost in the fray?

What is DX Legends?
DX Legends is an online battle arena with Zelda-like vibes where players fight to rescue the princess, but so do their rivals! Expect intense battles, unpredictable encounters, and a variety of playstyles to match your strategy.

Multiple kingdoms & maps to explore and conquer
Diverse battle modes for all kinds of players
Unique items & abilities to create your perfect playstyle
Cross-play multiplayer (PC, Mac, Linux & Mobile)
Co-op mode for a more relaxed adventure
Character customization: create, share, and download Legends!
Will you fight alone or team up? Will you be the one to claim victory?

Game Modes
Save the Princess – Battle solo or in teams to rescue the princess before your rivals do!
Deathmatch (Solo & Team) – Pure, unfiltered chaos. No objectives, just destruction!
Legends Mode – Conquer zones, collect golden pieces, and defeat the Dark Lord first.
Dungeon Raider – ??? (New game mode in development!)
Every match is different. Every battle is a legend in the making.

Customize Your Legend!
Choose from a roster of legendary heroes or create your own using the in-game editor.
Upload your unique characters and download Legends from players worldwide.
Your character, your rules, your legend.
Release Date & Early Access
No official release date yet, but you can play for free in the Alpha version!

Join the Discord server to be among the first to access the game!
https://discord.com/invite/s854bSBk6y

Read more at https://www.dxlegends.com
